transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... I guess I'm here because work has been an issue lately. I just... I can’t really make myself go near the front windows anymore. Or that part of the street. I keep finding excuses to just stay in the back room, even though... well, even though being out there is part of my job.
Is avoiding that part of the street or the front windows something you feel like you're doing on purpose, or does it feel more like something you just can't make yourself do?

Um... I don't really know. Like I said, it's... it's more like I just can't. I don't really plan it out on purpose, I just... find excuses to stay in the back room instead. I just can't make myself go up there right now.
When you think about going near the front windows or that part of the street, do you feel afraid or anxious?
Um... I don't really know if I'd use those words. I just... I really don't like being up there. It's just uncomfortable, I guess. I try not to think about it too much.
Is there something specific that happened near the front windows or that part of the street that makes you want to avoid it?
Um... yeah. I mean, it started about two weeks ago. I was working the overnight shift and... well, a car crashed right through the front window. So... yeah. Ever since then, I guess.
Do you avoid other places or situations that remind you of the car crash?
Um... not really, no. I just... I don't know. I just go to work and go home, mostly. I haven't really noticed anything else.
Do you find yourself thinking about the car crash when you don't want to?

Um... yeah, I guess. It just... kind of pops into my head sometimes. Out of nowhere, really. Like when I'm... um, when I'm trying to set up displays at work. I just suddenly... I hear the bang again. And see all the glass coming down. It's... I don't know, it's like it's happening right then. I try to just shake it off, though.
Do you try to avoid talking or thinking about the car crash?

Um... no, not really. I mean, I don't really talk about it with anyone anyway, so... I guess I don't have to avoid it. And the thoughts just kind of happen. I don't really try to stop them or anything.
How long have you been having these uncomfortable thoughts and feelings about the front windows and the street?
Um... about two weeks. Yeah, two weeks. Ever since that overnight shift... when the car came through the window. It's just been since then.
Has your avoidance of the front windows and that part of the street caused any problems for you at work or in your personal life?

Um... yeah, I guess. I mean... the other day, I was supposed to do a window reset. But I... I just couldn't finish it. I had to leave in the middle of it. So... yeah. I don't know if I can even do the parts of my job near the front anymore.
Have you been feeling overwhelmed or unable to cope with your daily life since the car crash happened?
Um... I don't know. I guess I'm just... getting through the days. It's just work and home, really. I'm not... I wouldn't say I'm overwhelmed, exactly. Just... dealing with it.
Has your inability to go near the front windows or that part of the street caused problems in your relationships with friends or family?
Um... no, not really. I mean, my family doesn't come into the store, so... it doesn't really affect them. And I haven't really talked to my friends about it. So... no, no problems like that.
Have you noticed any changes in your relationships or daily activities outside of work since the car crash happened?
Um... not really. I mean... I just go home after work. I don't do much else anyway. So... no, nothing's really changed.
Have you been avoiding social activities or interactions with others since the car crash happened?
Um... no. Not really. I mean... like I said before, I usually just stay in anyway. It's not like I'm... avoiding people on purpose or anything. I just haven't been doing much.
Has your difficulty going near the front windows or that part of the street caused any significant problems in your relationships with coworkers?

Um... well... I guess a little. The other day, I was supposed to help reset the front window display, and... I just couldn't do it. I had to leave right in the middle of it. So... my manager had to find someone else to finish it. Now I'm just... I'm worried I won't be able to do any of the stuff up front anymore.
Have you felt like your inability to go near the front windows has significantly impacted your overall job performance or ability to function at work?

Um... yeah, I guess so. Like I said, I... I had to walk away from that window reset. I just couldn't finish it. And... I don't know. I'm just really worried that I can't handle any of the work up by the storefront now. It's... it's a problem.
Do you find yourself trying to push away or avoid memories of the car crash when they come into your mind?
Um... no, not really. I don't... I don't really try to push them away or anything. I just... I don't know, they just kind of happen.
Have you felt like your inability to go near the front windows has affected your relationships with friends or family in any way?
Um... no, not really. It hasn't... I don't think it's really come up with them. It's mostly just... just a work thing.
Do you find yourself avoiding things that remind you of the car crash, such as talking about it or seeing cars similar to the one involved?
Um... no. I don't think so. I don't really talk about it anyway, so... I haven't really noticed avoiding it. And cars are just kind of everywhere, so... no, not really.
